description: Every host the extension.dev MCP server reaches, what it sends there, and how to turn it off. src/__tests__/network-egress.test.ts fails when the source names a host this file does not hold.

hosts.reachedBy: extension_docs_search (local group, no login); every platform tool, login and the guided store connect (platform group)
hosts.sends: Docs search: the query text and the result limit, with no login and no id header. Platform tools: the access token, the per-install id header (x-extensiondev-install), the project ref and the tool's arguments; a shared preview uploads the build it made, a project created from a folder uploads that folder, a listing write uploads its images, a capture sync uploads the capture files.
hosts.login: Docs search: none. Platform tools: the stored login or EXTENSION_DEV_TOKEN.
hosts.optOut: Do not call extension_docs_search. Platform tools stay off unless --features names platform. EXTENSION_DEV_NO_TELEMETRY=1 or DO_NOT_TRACK=1 drops the id header.

hosts.reachedBy: the platform tools answered by the hosted lane (platform group)
hosts.sends: A credential that lasts ten minutes, the tool's arguments and the project ref; a store check or a listing sync also sends the text of STORE.md, the icon and screenshot sizes and digests, and the git HEAD. Never the login, a file path or the api override.
hosts.login: A ten-minute credential exchanged at www.extension.dev, never the login.
hosts.optOut: Platform tools stay off unless --features names platform.

hosts.reachedBy: extension_templates and extension_create (the template catalog); extension_try and the build reads (published builds)
hosts.sends: Catalog requests carry nothing but the URL. A build read sends the project ref in the URL and, for a private project, a read grant.
hosts.login: Catalog: none. Private build reads: a short read grant.
hosts.optOut: Do not call extension_templates, extension_create or extension_try.

hosts.sends: The template's path and the catalog commit in the URL.
hosts.optOut: Do not call extension_templates with action source.

hosts.reachedBy: extension_templates with action source (the template's file tree, answered as filesSource: "tree")
hosts.sends: The catalog commit in the URL.
hosts.optOut: Do not call extension_templates with action source.

hosts.sends: The template catalog commit in the URL.

hosts.reachedBy: extension_create (the project's dependency install) and every engine command when the project has no engine of its own (npx extension@<version>)
hosts.sends: The package names and versions being installed.
hosts.optOut: Call extension_create with install: false and install the project's engine yourself.

hosts.sends: One draft_seeded event: the template slug, source and commit, and a random per-process id. Never a path or a name.

hosts.reachedBy: the guided store connect on Chrome (downloads the extension.dev tools extension from the Chrome Web Store)
hosts.sends: The extension id and the browser version in the URL; the download follows the store's redirect.
hosts.optOut: Platform tools stay off unless --features names platform; a failed download falls back to the copy this package bundles.

hosts.reachedBy: the guided store connect on Edge (downloads the extension.dev tools extension from Edge Add-ons)
hosts.sends: The extension id in the URL; the download follows the store's redirect.
hosts.optOut: Platform tools stay off unless --features names platform; a failed download falls back to the copy this package bundles.

hosts.reachedBy: the guided store connect on Firefox (reads and downloads the extension.dev tools add-on from Firefox Add-ons)
hosts.sends: The add-on id in the URL.
hosts.optOut: Platform tools stay off unless --features names platform; a failed download falls back to the copy this package bundles.

hosts.reachedBy: extension_browsers_install for Chrome (reads the available versions)
hosts.optOut: Do not call extension_browsers_install; point the tools at a browser already installed.

hosts.sends: The version and platform in the URL.
hosts.optOut: Do not call extension_browsers_install; point the tools at a browser already installed.

hosts.reachedBy: extension_browsers_install for Firefox (reads the available versions)
hosts.optOut: Do not call extension_browsers_install; point the tools at a browser already installed.

hosts.sends: The version and platform in the URL.
hosts.optOut: Do not call extension_browsers_install; point the tools at a browser already installed.

hosts.sends: The version and platform in the URL.
hosts.optOut: Do not call extension_browsers_install; point the tools at a browser already installed.

hosts.sends: The version and platform in the URL.
hosts.optOut: Do not call extension_browsers_install; point the tools at a browser already installed.

hosts.reachedBy: extension_browsers_install for Edge on Linux (the package)
hosts.sends: The version and platform in the URL.
hosts.optOut: Do not call extension_browsers_install; point the tools at a browser already installed.

notes: notReached lists the hosts the source names only in links a person opens, never in a request this server sends.
Every browser the server launches loads whatever pages the person or the agent opens in it; those requests are the browser's, not this server's.
Loopback addresses (localhost, 127.0.0.1) are the browsers' debug ports and local development servers and never leave the machine.
